tagline: 1970s NASA outer-planet workhorse — Pioneer 10/11, Helios 1/2, Mariner 9/10, Pioneer Venus
description: Stretched Atlas SLV-3D first stage with the world's first hydrogen-fuelled upper stage (Centaur D-1A, LOX/LH₂) — the combination that enabled every American Jupiter, Saturn, Mariner, and Helios mission of the 1970s. A Star-37E or Star-48 solid-kick stage was added on top for the very-high-energy trajectories (Pioneer 11 past Jupiter to Saturn). Served 1973-1983; superseded by the Atlas G/H/I family that fed into the Atlas II of the 1990s.
best_known_for: 1970s NASA outer-planet workhorse — Centaur D-1A's first H₂ upper stage opened the gas giants
